units: cqw = % of canvas width, cqh = % of canvas height, em = of the element's font size

glass_panel.cite: look/measure.json glass_panel 41911984 + 41432513 (medians); blur = sigma of the Gaussian whose blurred backdrop best predicts the inside (max R^2); rim dL 1.22, -0.01 and edge shadow dL -0.56, -1.08 are under 1.5 L*, so neither is built
glass_panel.judgment: tint hue: the board's glass takes the hue of the photo behind it (measured #a9bea4, #909a82); the kit uses the palette surface role at the measured alpha

glass_band.cite: look/measure.json glass_band 2145281 (R^2 still rising at sigma 64 px: blur is at least this)

pill_chip.font: label role (Neue Haas Grotesk Display Pro 55 Roman), sentence case
pill_chip.cite: look/measure.json pill_chip (5 exemplars; cap height from the 3 whose text detection held)
pill_chip.judgment: fills map to palette roles: measured #fefffe, #dddee2, #fbfbfc, #1f3916

step_marks.cite: look/measure.json step_marks 34175362 (Hough circles); stroke floored at the hairline rule

meta_label.font: label role (Neue Haas Grotesk Display Pro 55 Roman), caps, tracking 0.0102 em
meta_label.cite: look/measure.json meta_footer 27454113; left edge = composition/grid.json margin (27454113 measured 10.0%)

dark_card.judgment: ground = palette text #211b15 (the board's warm black), not pure #000

vertical_type.cite: catalog.json vertical_type (4 images); type from fonts/specimen/spec.json

icon_outline.cite: stroke = ring_button 13607089 stroke 2 px on a 750 px canvas (0.267 cqw), drawn at 6 cqw on a 24 grid
icon_outline.judgment: display size 6 cqw and round caps/joins, read from the close/menu/send icons on 11460382, 13607089, 14664481

dotted_path.cite: judgment: a dashed hairline (thickness 0.139 cqw = the rule), dash 0.3 cqw / gap 0.28 cqw (about 3 px / 3 px at 1080), matched to 34175362 in the step_marks proof; the runs are too JPEG-soft to measure

grain.cite: colour/treatment.json board.grain and grain_add_sigma; overlay opacity calibrated in proof (look/proof_check.json); overlay opacity 0.06 gives sigma 0.0026 on a flat mid-tone (look/proof_check.json grain)

photo_treatment.css_filter_cite: grid search (saturate, sepia, contrast, brightness) minimising median CIE76 dE to the LUT on 24000 pixels sampled from existing/thumbs
